title: Software Engineer
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter. About the role We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix. Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones. Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself. Design. Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers. Quality. Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them. Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next. Code reviews. Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've shipped code that runs in production. Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes. You are strong at problem solving. You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments. We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in. Technical background You've built production software with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it. Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript. Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents. Databases: solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it. Fundamentals: data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability. One problem you went deep on. A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why. Ownership beyond the ticket. You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked. Framework mindset: You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable. Learning speed. You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it. Curiosity about the user. You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them. Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written. Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work. Independence. You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to. Depth. At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary technical representative for audio validation in leadership reviews. Partner with acoustic, mechanical, and electrical engineers to root-cause hardware failures, mitigate acoustic artifacts (e.g., rub and buzz), and optimize acoustic seals. Factory Support: Support contract manufacturers (CMs) during early builds. Transfer validation test limits and methodologies to factory production lines to ensure consistent manufacturing quality. Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of electroacoustics, transducer design principles (microphones and micro-speakers), and audio signal processing fundamentals. Proven track record of shipping high-volume consumer audio electronics, specifically wearable or hearable devices. Laboratory Proficiency: Extensive hands-on experience setting up and operating acoustic test environments, including anechoic chambers, isolation booths, and specialized audio measurement equipment. Automation Skills: Strong programming and scripting skills (Python, MATLAB, C++) for automating test equipment and analyzing large datasets. Analytical Skills: Exceptional problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach to root-cause analysis and statistical process control. SoundCheck, Klippel R&D System, HEAD acoustics ACQUA. description: Job Description Technical Architect Position: Technical Architect / Solution Architect Experience: 10- 15 Years Primary Cloud Platform: AWS Employment Type: Full-Time Job Summary We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Technical Architect with strong expertise in AWS cloud architecture, serverless application development, full-stack technologies, and enterprise solution design. The ideal candidate should have proven experience in architecting, developing, and delivering scalable, secure, reliable, and cost-effective enterprise applications using cloud-native, microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures. This role requires a combination of strong architectural expertise, hands-on technical capabilities, problem-solving skills, and technical leadership. The candidate will be responsible for driving architecture decisions, guiding development teams, collaborating with clients and stakeholders, and ensuring end-to-end technical delivery across projects. Key Responsibilities 1. Solution Architecture & System Design Design scalable, secure, reliable, maintainable, and cost-effective enterprise applications. Define and implement solution architectures using microservices, serverless, cloud-native, and event-driven design patterns. Design RESTful APIs, distributed systems, integration architectures, and third-party integrations. Evaluate technology choices, architectural approaches, technical feasibility, and associated trade-offs. Prepare architecture diagrams, technical design documents, solution specifications, and implementation guidelines. Identify architectural risks, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for optimization. Lead application modernization, legacy system transformation, and cloud migration initiatives. Ensure architectural solutions align with business objectives, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements. 2. AWS Cloud & Serverless Architecture Design, develop, and implement cloud-native and serverless applications using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and S3 . Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot AWS Lambda functions using Node.js and Python. Design synchronous and asynchronous processing workflows, event-driven integrations, and distributed application architectures. Implement workflow orchestration, message queues, background processing, and event-based communication between services. Design highly available, fault-tolerant, scalable, and secure cloud solutions. Implement robust error handling, retry mechanisms, dead-letter queues, idempotency, and failure recovery strategies. Optimize AWS Lambda performance, concurrency, cold starts, execution time, and operational costs. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated deployments using AWS SAM and CloudFormation. Configure IAM roles, policies, authentication, authorization, and secure service-to-service communication. Implement monitoring and observability using Amazon CloudWatch, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting. Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues involving AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and other cloud services. Work with additional AWS infrastructure services, including EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, VPC, Elastic Load Balancing, EFS, Cognito, Secrets Manager, and CloudTrail, as required. Evaluate cloud infrastructure for performance, security, reliability, scalability, and cost optimization. 3. Full-Stack Development & Technical Expertise Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance for applications developed using: Backend: Node.js, Python, REST APIs, and microservices. Frontend: React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Databases: PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and DynamoDB. Design and review RESTful APIs, reusable services, integration components, and application frameworks. Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, development guidelines, and software engineering best practices. Conduct technical design reviews, code reviews, and implementation assessments. Support developers in resolving complex technical challenges and integration issues. Participate in critical development activities, debugging, performance tuning, and application optimization. Ensure applications meet quality, security, scalability, and maintainability standards. 4. Database Design & Architecture Design and optimize relational and NoSQL database architectures using PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and DynamoDB. Define data models, database schemas, indexing strategies, and query optimization approaches. Design reliable data synchronization, migration, and integration workflows. Ensure data integrity, consistency, security, availability, and performance. Evaluate database technologies and recommend appropriate solutions based on application requirements. Support database modernization, performance optimization, and integration with cloud-native applications. 5. Technical Leadership & Delivery Provide technical direction, architectural guidance, and mentorship to development teams. Lead architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code review processes. Collaborate with project managers, business analysts, developers, QA engineers, and DevOps teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Participate in technical estimations, project planning, implementation strategies, and delivery activities. Identify technical risks, dependencies, and blockers, and recommend appropriate solutions. Ensure adherence to architectural standards, coding practices, and quality guidelines. Take ownership of critical technical decisions, complex implementation challenges, and production issues. Drive technical delivery while ensuring alignment with business requirements, project timelines, and quality expectations. 6. Client Communication & Stakeholder Management Collaborate directly with clients and stakeholders to understand business objectives, functional requirements, and technical expectations. Translate business requirements into practical, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions. Present solution architectures, technical proposals, and design recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Explain architectural decisions, implementation approaches, technical risks, and trade-offs. Participate in requirement analysis, solution discussions, technical evaluations, and project planning. Provide recommendations that balance business priorities, technical feasibility, delivery timelines, and cost considerations. Act as a technical point of contact for architecture-related discussions and critical technical decisions. 7. DevOps, Security & Production Readiness Support CI/CD pipeline design, automated deployments, and release management processes. Work with Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application environments. Implement secure authentication and authorization using AWS Cognito, IAM, OAuth 2.0, and JWT. Apply cloud security best practices, including least-privilege access, secrets management, and secure API communication. Design and implement application monitoring, centralized logging, alerting, and observability mechanisms. Ensure applications meet production-readiness requirements related to reliability, availability, scalability, security, and performance. Support disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and operational resilience strategies. Knowledge of AWS Bedrock, AI/ML frameworks, and Python FastAPI. Experience with Amazon OpenSearch, Redis, and distributed caching solutions. Knowledge of Flutter or other cross-platform mobile application frameworks. Experience modernizing legacy enterprise applications and migrating workloads to cloud-native architectures. Exposure to other cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Familiarity with Terraform and advanced Infrastructure as Code practices. Experience with container orchestration and Kubernetes-based deployments. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 10+ years of professional software development experience , including at least 3 years in a technical architecture or technical leadership role. Strong hands-on experience in AWS cloud services, particularly AWS Lambda and serverless application development. Proven experience designing, developing, and delivering enterprise-grade cloud applications. Strong technical proficiency in backend development, API architecture, and modern application frameworks. Solid understanding of software architecture principles, design patterns, distributed systems, and database technologies. Experience leading technical discussions, guiding development teams, and collaborating with clients. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to independently manage architectural responsibilities and technical delivery across multiple projects.
